mechanism: Omeprazole reduces gastric acid and increases gastric pH, which decreases the absorption and bioavailability of penicillin VK, a pH-sensitive beta-lactam antibiotic.
action: Monitor clinical response for reduced efficacy; consider alternative antibiotics less affected by pH (such as amoxicillin or cephalosporins) or separate dosing by 2 hours if penicillin VK must be used.
